decisions.reason: The supplier is stated for time-oriented manifolds, whereas the Definition permits non-time-orientable backgrounds. This is a missing local scope justification, not a false curvature formula: a local timelike field selects a cone, unique torsion-free metric connections agree on overlaps independently of that cone, and curvature and metric contractions glue. Added that argument in Scope justification, preserving the entire Definition and its domain. The finite-jet chain rule still gives compactly supported, family-independent first density derivatives and the tensors remain supplied inputs, with no existence assertion.

The original covariance clause compares identical metrics even when the prescribed potentials differ. For an isometry, P(psi* f)-psi*(P′ f)=(V-psi*V′)psi* f, so metric preservation alone does not identify the operators or their singular subtraction data. Restricted the embeddings to V=psi*V′, fixed the compared scale/finite conditions, and required matching pulled-back two-point distributions only for expectation comparisons. The smooth-remainder formula then commutes with restriction and diagonal evaluation; no preferred state or parametrix existence is asserted.

The original absence-of-variables observation did not prove the central uniform non-implication. Replaced it by a conditional counterfamily starting from the supplied candidate: C^(q)=C+qg satisfies exactly the stated local, covariant, conserved correction contract, retains the same positive Hadamard state and all ODE data, and gives R^(q)(u,u)=R^(0)(u,u)+(8piG/c^4)q for a normalized timelike u. Any finite ODE-only bound is exceeded by a finite q. Every prescription fixes its constants within its domain; this proves no instability or divergence in one fixed model, and no existence theorem or empirical observation is invented.
